github-pages.deploy.yml:
# Publishes ./app to this repository's own GitHub Pages site.
# Runs on every change to app/ and on demand (Actions tab -> Deploy -> Run workflow).
name: Deploy
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['app/**']

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: app
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
      - name: Live URL
        run: echo "Live at ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

aws.deploy.yml:
# Creates an S3 bucket + CloudFront distribution in YOUR AWS account with
# OpenTofu and uploads ./app to it. State is encrypted with OpenTofu's native
# state encryption (key: the TOFU_STATE_PASSPHRASE secret) and committed to
# state/ in this repository.
name: Deploy
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['app/**', 'tofu/**.tf']

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: tofu
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  apply:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
      AWS_REGION: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION || 'us-east-1' }}
      BUDGET_EMAIL: ${{ vars.BUDGET_EMAIL }}
      BUDGET_AMOUNT: ${{ vars.BUDGET_AMOUNT || '10' }}
      PASSPHRASE: ${{ secrets.TOFU_STATE_PASSPHRASE }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: opentofu/setup-opentofu@v1
        with:
          tofu_version: 1.8.5
      - name: tofu apply
        working-directory: tofu
        run: |
          export TF_ENCRYPTION="$(sed "s/__PASSPHRASE__/${PASSPHRASE}/" encryption.hcl.tmpl)"
          mkdir -p ../state
          tofu init -input=false
          tofu apply -input=false -auto-approve -state=../state/terraform.tfstate \
            -var "name=${{ github.event.repository.name }}" -var "budget_email=${BUDGET_EMAIL}" -var "budget_amount=${BUDGET_AMOUNT}"
          echo "Live at $(tofu output -raw url)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Commit encrypted state
        run: |
          git config user.name "deploy-bot"
          git config user.email "deploy-bot@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add state
          git diff --cached --quiet || { git commit -m "state: encrypted OpenTofu state" && git push; }
aws.destroy.yml:
# Tears everything the Deploy workflow created back down. Run it from the
# Actions tab; it asks for nothing but a click.
name: Destroy
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: tofu
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  destroy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
      AWS_REGION: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION || 'us-east-1' }}
      PASSPHRASE: ${{ secrets.TOFU_STATE_PASSPHRASE }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: opentofu/setup-opentofu@v1
        with:
          tofu_version: 1.8.5
      - name: tofu destroy
        working-directory: tofu
        run: |
          export TF_ENCRYPTION="$(sed "s/__PASSPHRASE__/${PASSPHRASE}/" encryption.hcl.tmpl)"
          tofu init -input=false
          tofu destroy -input=false -auto-approve -state=../state/terraform.tfstate \
            -var "name=${{ github.event.repository.name }}"
      - name: Drop the state file
        run: |
          git config user.name "deploy-bot"
          git config user.email "deploy-bot@users.noreply.github.com"
          git rm -rq --ignore-unmatch state
          git diff --cached --quiet || { git commit -m "state: destroyed" && git push; }
aws.tofu/README.md:
# AWS static hosting module (OpenTofu)

S3 (private) + CloudFront (HTTPS) for the static site in `../app`.

Run it from your own machine instead of GitHub Actions:

```
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=... AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=... AWS_REGION=us-east-1
export TF_ENCRYPTION="$(sed 's/__PASSPHRASE__/choose-a-long-passphrase/' encryption.hcl.tmpl)"
tofu init
tofu apply -var name=my-site -state=../state/terraform.tfstate
# optional: -var budget_email=you@example.com -var budget_amount=10   (a monthly AWS budget alert, see budget.tf)
tofu destroy -var name=my-site -state=../state/terraform.tfstate   # tear down
```

Needs OpenTofu 1.8.5. The state file is encrypted with the passphrase above;
keep the passphrase, or you cannot destroy what you created.
aws.tofu/budget.tf:
# A monthly cost budget for the AWS account, so a bill that grows (a traffic
# spike, a leaked key, a resource left running) emails you before the invoice
# does. AWS budgets cover the whole account, not just this site. Off unless
# budget_email is set: the deploy key may lack budgets:ModifyBudget.
resource "aws_budgets_budget" "monthly" {
  count        = var.budget_email == "" ? 0 : 1
  name         = "${var.name}-monthly"
  budget_type  = "COST"
  limit_amount = tostring(var.budget_amount)
  limit_unit   = "USD"
  time_unit    = "MONTHLY"

  notification {
    comparison_operator        = "GREATER_THAN"
    threshold                  = 80
    threshold_type             = "PERCENTAGE"
    notification_type          = "ACTUAL"
    subscriber_email_addresses = [var.budget_email]
  }

  notification {
    comparison_operator        = "GREATER_THAN"
    threshold                  = 100
    threshold_type             = "PERCENTAGE"
    notification_type          = "FORECASTED"
    subscriber_email_addresses = [var.budget_email]
  }
}

gcp.tofu/README.md:
# Google Cloud Storage hosting module (OpenTofu)

A public Cloud Storage bucket holding the static site in `../app`, served over
HTTPS from `https://storage.googleapis.com/<bucket>/index.html`.

Run it from your own machine instead of GitHub Actions:

```
export GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS="$(cat service-account-key.json)"
export TF_ENCRYPTION="$(sed 's/__PASSPHRASE__/choose-a-long-passphrase/' encryption.hcl.tmpl)"
tofu init
tofu apply -var name=my-site -var project=my-gcp-project -state=../state/terraform.tfstate
# optional: -var billing_account=XXXXXX-XXXXXX-XXXXXX -var budget_amount=10   (a monthly budget alert, see budget.tf)
tofu destroy -var name=my-site -var project=my-gcp-project -state=../state/terraform.tfstate   # tear down
```

Needs OpenTofu 1.8.5 and a service account with Storage Admin on the project.
If your organization enforces "public access prevention", the bucket cannot be
public and the apply fails; use another provider or relax that policy.
The state file is encrypted with the passphrase above; keep the passphrase, or
you cannot destroy what you created.
gcp.tofu/main.tf:
# Static site in a Google Cloud Storage bucket, readable by everyone over HTTPS
# at https://storage.googleapis.com/<bucket>/index.html. Every asset path in the
# apps is relative, so they work under that prefix. For your own domain, put a
# load balancer or Firebase Hosting in front later; this module stays simple.

provider "google" {
  project = var.project
}

resource "random_id" "suffix" {
  byte_length = 4
}

locals {
  bucket = substr(lower(replace("${var.name}-${random_id.suffix.hex}", "/[^a-z0-9-]/", "-")), 0, 63)

  mime = {
    html        = "text/html; charset=utf-8"
    htm         = "text/html; charset=utf-8"
    css         = "text/css; charset=utf-8"
    js          = "text/javascript; charset=utf-8"
    mjs         = "text/javascript; charset=utf-8"
    json        = "application/json"
    svg         = "image/svg+xml"
    png         = "image/png"
    jpg         = "image/jpeg"
    jpeg        = "image/jpeg"
    gif         = "image/gif"
    webp        = "image/webp"
    ico         = "image/x-icon"
    txt         = "text/plain; charset=utf-8"
    xml         = "application/xml"
    csv         = "text/csv; charset=utf-8"
    woff        = "font/woff"
    woff2       = "font/woff2"
    webmanifest = "application/manifest+json"
  }

  files = fileset(var.app_dir, "**")
}

resource "google_storage_bucket" "site" {
  name                        = local.bucket
  location                    = var.location
  force_destroy               = true
  uniform_bucket_level_access = true

  website {
    main_page_suffix = "index.html"
  }
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "public_read" {
  bucket = google_storage_bucket.site.name
  role   = "roles/storage.objectViewer"
  member = "allUsers"
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_object" "file" {
  for_each     = local.files
  bucket       = google_storage_bucket.site.name
  name         = each.value
  source       = "${var.app_dir}/${each.value}"
  content_type = lookup(local.mime, lower(element(reverse(split(".", each.value)), 0)), "application/octet-stream")
  # Re-upload when the file changes.
  detect_md5hash = filemd5("${var.app_dir}/${each.value}")
}

azure.tofu/README.md:
# Azure Storage static website module (OpenTofu)

A StorageV2 account with the static-website feature on, holding the site in
`../app`, served over HTTPS from the account's web endpoint
(`https://<account>.z13.web.core.windows.net/`). It creates its own resource
group, so destroying it removes everything it made.

Run it from your own machine instead of GitHub Actions:

```
export ARM_CLIENT_ID=... ARM_CLIENT_SECRET=... ARM_TENANT_ID=... ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID=...
export TF_ENCRYPTION="$(sed 's/__PASSPHRASE__/choose-a-long-passphrase/' encryption.hcl.tmpl)"
tofu init
tofu apply -var name=my-site -state=../state/terraform.tfstate
# optional: -var budget_email=you@example.com -var budget_amount=10   (a monthly budget alert, see budget.tf)
tofu destroy -var name=my-site -state=../state/terraform.tfstate   # tear down
```

Needs OpenTofu 1.8.5 and a service principal with the Contributor role on the
subscription (or on a resource group you pre-create). Make one with
`az ad sp create-for-rbac --role Contributor --scopes /subscriptions/<id>`.
The state file is encrypted with the passphrase above; keep the passphrase, or
you cannot destroy what you created.
azure.tofu/main.tf:
# Static site in an Azure Storage account with the static-website feature on,
# served over HTTPS from the account's web endpoint
# (https://<account>.z13.web.core.windows.net/). Every asset path in the apps is
# relative, so they work there. For your own domain, put Azure Front Door or a
# CDN endpoint in front later; this module stays simple.

provider "azurerm" {
  features {}
}

resource "random_id" "suffix" {
  byte_length = 4
}

locals {
  # Storage account names: 3-24 characters, lowercase letters and digits only.
  account = "${substr(replace(lower(var.name), "/[^a-z0-9]/", ""), 0, 15)}${random_id.suffix.hex}"

  mime = {
    html        = "text/html; charset=utf-8"
    htm         = "text/html; charset=utf-8"
    css         = "text/css; charset=utf-8"
    js          = "text/javascript; charset=utf-8"
    mjs         = "text/javascript; charset=utf-8"
    json        = "application/json"
    svg         = "image/svg+xml"
    png         = "image/png"
    jpg         = "image/jpeg"
    jpeg        = "image/jpeg"
    gif         = "image/gif"
    webp        = "image/webp"
    ico         = "image/x-icon"
    txt         = "text/plain; charset=utf-8"
    xml         = "application/xml"
    csv         = "text/csv; charset=utf-8"
    woff        = "font/woff"
    woff2       = "font/woff2"
    webmanifest = "application/manifest+json"
  }

  files = fileset(var.app_dir, "**")
}

resource "azurerm_resource_group" "site" {
  name     = "${substr(var.name, 0, 60)}-${random_id.suffix.hex}"
  location = var.location
}

resource "azurerm_storage_account" "site" {
  name                            = local.account
  resource_group_name             = azurerm_resource_group.site.name
  location                        = azurerm_resource_group.site.location
  account_tier                    = "Standard"
  account_replication_type        = "LRS"
  account_kind                    = "StorageV2"
  min_tls_version                 = "TLS1_2"
  https_traffic_only_enabled      = true
  allow_nested_items_to_be_public = false
}

resource "azurerm_storage_account_static_website" "site" {
  storage_account_id = azurerm_storage_account.site.id
  index_document     = "index.html"
  error_404_document = "index.html"
}

resource "azurerm_storage_blob" "file" {
  for_each               = local.files
  name                   = each.value
  storage_account_name   = azurerm_storage_account.site.name
  storage_container_name = "$web"
  type                   = "Block"
  source                 = "${var.app_dir}/${each.value}"
  content_type           = lookup(local.mime, lower(element(reverse(split(".", each.value)), 0)), "application/octet-stream")
  # Re-upload when the file changes.
  content_md5 = filemd5("${var.app_dir}/${each.value}")

  depends_on = [azurerm_storage_account_static_website.site]
}

cloudflare.deploy.yml:
# Publishes ./app to Cloudflare Pages in YOUR Cloudflare account with wrangler.
# Runs on every change to app/ and on demand (Actions tab -> Deploy -> Run workflow).
name: Deploy
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['app/**']

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: cloudflare-pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
      CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
      PROJECT: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Create the Pages project (a no-op if it already exists)
        run: npx --yes wrangler@3.99.0 pages project create "$PROJECT" --production-branch=main || true
      - name: Deploy
        run: npx --yes wrangler@3.99.0 pages deploy app --project-name="$PROJECT" --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
      - name: Live URL
        run: echo "Live at https://${PROJECT}.pages.dev (the exact name is in the wrangler output above if Cloudflare added a suffix)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

android.deploy.yml:
# Builds an Android app (Capacitor) around ./app and publishes it as a workflow artifact.
#   - always: a debug APK you can sideload onto your own phone (no Google account needed)
#   - only if you set the four ANDROID_* secrets: a signed release bundle (.aab) for Google Play
# Runs on every change to app/ and on demand (Actions tab -> Deploy -> Run workflow).
name: Deploy
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['app/**', 'capacitor.config.json', 'package.json']

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: android
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  android:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64 }}
      ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
      ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
      ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17
      - name: Install Capacitor
        run: npm install --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Create the Android project from app/
        run: |
          npx cap add android
          npx cap sync android
      - name: Build debug APK
        working-directory: android
        run: ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: app-debug-apk
          path: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
      - name: Build and sign release bundle (only with your keystore secrets)
        if: ${{ env.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64 != '' && env.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD != '' && env.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS != '' && env.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD != '' }}
        working-directory: android
        run: |
          ./gradlew --no-daemon bundleRelease
          printf '%s' "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64" | base64 -d > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release.keystore"
          jarsigner -keystore "$RUNNER_TEMP/release.keystore" \
            -storepass:env ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD -keypass:env ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD \
            app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab "$ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS"
          rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/release.keystore"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ env.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64 != '' && env.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD != '' && env.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS != '' && env.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD != '' }}
        with:
          name: app-release-aab
          path: android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab
      - name: Summary
        run: |
          {
            echo "Download the APK from this run's **Artifacts** list and install it on an Android phone you own."
            echo "A signed Play bundle is built only if you added the ANDROID_* secrets (see README.md)."
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
